description: Aguas residuales CyL: EDARU is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Servicio de Residuos y Suelos Contaminados. Dirección General de Calidad y Sostenibilidad Ambiental. Consejería de Fomento y Medio Ambiente. Urban wastewater treatment plants (EDARU) in Castilla y León. Location of urban waste water treatment plants, indicating the name of the operator and the operator of the installation. Coverage: Servicio de Residuos y Suelos Contaminados. Dirección General de Calidad y Sostenibilidad Ambiental. Consejería de Fomento y Medio Ambiente. The portal shows the English title as "CyL waste water: EDARU" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Servicio de Residuos y Suelos Contaminados. Dirección General de Calidad y Sostenibilidad Ambiental. Consejería de Fomento y Medio Ambiente. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2021-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
